title: A parsed fabric:// deep link (DEC-0040)
description: What a fabric:// link asks Fabric to open, after parsing: a conversation with Fabric scoped to a service, a project or both (fabric://chat), or a coding-agent session in a project (fabric://session/new). It names ids only and never a credential, a prompt or an instruction.
